column1: # Docs sample registry (#213). Single source of truth mapping a Markdown
# file plus sample id to its canonical compile-checked fixture.
# Paths are repository-relative with forward slashes. Lines starting with
# `#` and blank lines are ignored. kind defaults to `sample`; use
# `json-specimen` for JSON output specimens owned by #212 (Markdown marker
# `<!-- json-specimen: id -->`, fixture region `// json-specimen: id`).
# docs/**/*.md from the filesystem, so adding a guide needs no shell edit:
# an unregistered marker fails the build. verify-docs-samples.sh covers the
# docs scope and verify-sparsefragments-readme.sh covers README.md, both
# from this file; the id lists must not be duplicated anywhere else.
